news.title: Was I hacked?
news.summary:
I just logged into Base app with used to be Coinbase wallet. There was over $10k in there last month. Now The balance is $0. I’ve never shared my recovery phrase. Kinda freaking out a bit. That’s a lot of money to me.

submitted by /u/schprunt
